build_movie_mcan_model: build a MoVieMcan multimodal model by calling build() to initialize word embeddings, text embeddings, and image feature encoders
forward_movie_mcan_inference: run forward pass on a sample_list through MoVieMcan to get prediction scores for movie question answering
process_text_embedding_movie_mcan: process text embeddings from a sample_list using the text_embeddings module and return total and vector embeddings
process_feature_embedding_movie_mcan: process image feature embeddings by encoding features and applying SGA and CBN branches with text attention
get_optimizer_parameters_movie_mcan: get optimizer parameter groups for MoVieMcan with filtered gradients and differentiated learning rates for encoder layers
